title: SunSpec Explorer API v1 entities
description: Every entity of the Service interface and of the HTTP API v1 (/api/v1) of the OT Fabric SunSpec Explorer, as named definitions: reference one as api-1.schema.json#/$defs/<Name>, for example #/$defs/SessionInfo. This document itself constrains nothing. Request bodies: TargetConfig, SnapshotRequest, PollConfig, RecordingConfig, ExportRequest. All timestamps are UTC, RFC 3339. All register addresses are zero-based Modbus addresses. Fields described as omitted are absent, not null.

api_version.description: Version of the Service contract and of the HTTP API. The major part changes on incompatible changes, the minor part on additions.

registry_models.description: Number of SunSpec model schemas the library knows.

time.description: The engine's clock, for clients to notice a skew.

features.description: What this engine is set up for beyond the basics. Known features: recording, serial, tls.

SerialConfig.description: Settings of a serial line (rtu:// targets).

TargetConfig.description: What a client sends to open a session. Body of POST /api/v1/sessions.

url.description: tcp://host:port, rtuovertcp://host:port, tcp+tls://host:port or rtu://<serial device>. No credentials, path or query.

unit_id.description: Modbus unit ID: 1..247, or 255. 0 or absent selects 1.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds, 100..60000. 0 or absent selects the engine default.

base_addresses.description: Addresses probed for the SunSpec marker. Empty or absent selects the go-sunspec defaults.

max_models.description: Cap on the number of models read from the chain. 0 or absent selects the go-sunspec default.

url.description: tcp://host:port, rtuovertcp://host:port, tcp+tls://host:port or rtu://<device>; never with credentials.

ProbeAttempt.description: One base-address probe made during detection.

matched.description: The SunS marker was found at this address.

error.description: Why the probe failed; omitted when the device answered.

DeviceIdentity.description: Identification points of the Common model (model 1).

ModelInfo.description: One model instance found by discovery.

index.description: Position in the model chain. A device can hold several models with the same id.

start_address.description: Address of the model's ID register.

length.description: Number of data registers after the ID and length registers.

schema_known.description: The library has a schema of this model ID.

static_only.description: The model holds nothing that changes by itself (as Common): it is read once, not in every poll cycle.

SessionInfo.description: A session and the discovery result it reads from. Answer of POST /api/v1/sessions, GET /api/v1/sessions/{id} and POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/rediscover.

status.description: connected: the last exchange with the device succeeded. reconnecting: the device stopped answering and the engine retries with backoff. closed: the session was closed (seen in the last session_status event of a session only).

status_detail.description: Why the session is reconnecting; omitted otherwise.

device.description: Omitted when the device has no Common model or it could not be read.

models.description: The model chain, in chain order.

attempts.description: The probes of the last discovery.

type.description: SunSpec point type, for example int16, acc32, enum16, sunssf, string.

implemented.description: false: the device reports the SunSpec not-implemented value; raw then holds that sentinel, not a measurement.

raw.description: Unscaled value: a number, a string, a list of registers for a type that is not decoded, or null for a float that is not a number.

scaled.description: raw times 10^sf_raw, or null without a resolved scale factor.

sf_name.description: Name of the scale factor point.

sf_raw.description: Value of the scale factor point.

symbols.description: Names of the active enum value or bitfield flags.

address.description: Absolute address of the point's first register.

offset.description: Register offset from the model's ID register.

GroupView.description: One decoded group instance: its points and the group instances nested in it.

index.description: 1-based instance number within the parent; 0 for the top-level group.

ModelResult.description: The outcome of reading one model instance.

index.description: Position in the model chain. A device can hold several models with the same id.

start_address.description: Address of the model's ID register.

length.description: Number of data registers after the ID and length registers.

status.description: changed: the device no longer holds this model at this address.

error.description: Why the read failed; null when status is ok.

stale.description: While polling: the last good read of the model is older than two poll intervals.

last_ok_at.description: Time of the last good read of the model in this session; omitted when there was none.

group.description: The decoded model, or null when it was not decoded (no schema, or the read failed).

raw_registers.description: Data registers of a model without schema, or of every model when the request asked for them; otherwise null.

SnapshotRequest.description: What a single read covers. Body of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/snapshot; an empty body selects the defaults.

model_indexes.description: Chain positions. Empty or absent selects every model.

include_raw.description: Add the raw registers of decoded models too.

AppInfo.description: The application that wrote the file.

LibInfo.description: The libraries that decoded the data.

go_sunspec.description: Version of the go-sunspec library that decoded the data.

registry_models.description: Number of SunSpec model schemas the library knows.

Snapshot.description: One read of a device and, saved as a file, the snapshot export (the same document as snapshot-1.schema.json). Answer of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/snapshot.

captured_at.description: Start of the first request. Models are read one after another: a snapshot is not an atomic view of the device.

metadata.description: full: points carry label, description, access, mandatory and static. compact: they do not.

device.description: Identification from the Common model, or null when the device has none or it could not be read.

PollConfig.description: Body of PUT /api/v1/sessions/{id}/polling; an empty body selects the defaults.

interval_s.description: Start-to-start interval in whole seconds, 1..3600. 0 or absent selects 5.

model_indexes.description: Chain positions. Empty or absent selects every model that is not static-only; the static-only ones are then read once, in the first cycle.

interval_s.description: 0 when the session was never polled.

model_indexes.description: The selection polling was started with; empty for the default selection.

started_at.description: Omitted when the session was never polled.

failures.description: Cycles in which at least one model failed.

overruns.description: Ticks skipped because a cycle was still running.

Sample.description: The result of one poll cycle.

seq.description: Number of the sample within its polling run, starting at 1. It starts again at 1 when polling is started again.

captured_at.description: Start of the first request of the cycle. Models are read one after another: a sample is not an atomic view of the device.

overruns.description: Poll ticks skipped so far in this polling run because a cycle was still running.

metadata.description: Samples are compact: points carry no label, description, access, mandatory and static.

models.description: The models of this cycle. Static-only models are in the first sample of a run only, unless they were selected.

SessionState.description: Everything a client needs to resume showing a session. Answer of GET /api/v1/sessions/{id}/state.

last_sample.description: The last sample of the current polling run, or null.

recording.description: The running recording of the session, or null.

Event.description: One entry of the event stream: the JSON in the data field of a server-sent event of GET /api/v1/events.

seq.description: Increases by one per event of an engine; the id of the server-sent event. A resync carries the number of the last event before it.

kind.description: sample: a poll cycle ended (sample; recording with the counters while the session records). session_status: a session was opened, closed, lost or found again (session). discovery_changed: the model chain was discovered again (session). recording_status: a recording started or stopped (recording). error: something failed in the background (message). resync: the subscriber missed events and must fetch the state of its sessions again.

RecordingConfig.description: Body of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/recordings; an empty body selects the defaults.

name.description: Base name of the recording files, never a path. Empty or absent lets the engine choose one.

rotate_bytes.description: Start a new file after this many bytes. 0 or absent selects the engine default.

RecordingInfo.description: A recording. Answer of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/recordings and POST /api/v1/recordings/{rid}/stop. The lines of the recording itself (GET /api/v1/recordings/{rid}/download) are described by recording-1.schema.json.

state.description: interrupted: the engine was killed while the recording ran; the file has no footer.

stopped_at.description: Omitted while running. For an interrupted recording: the time of the last write.

stop_reason.description: Why a stopped recording stopped; omitted while running and when interrupted. user: stopped by the user. limit: size, total size or age limit. disk_space: the free-space floor was reached. session_closed: the session was closed. shutdown: the engine was shut down. error: a write failed.

failures.description: Samples in which at least one model failed.

files.description: Number of files the recording is split into.

location.description: Directory that holds the recording on the engine's host, for display only.

temporary.description: location is ephemeral storage: save a copy.

SerialPort.description: A serial device the engine is allowed to open.

format.description: csv: one row per point (long format). devicefile: a device file for sunspecctl serve.

ExportFile.description: A file rendered by the engine for the client to save. Answer of POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/export.

Error.description: The error of every Service method.

code.description: Clients switch on it. HTTP status: invalid_argument 400 (416 for a range beyond a recording), unauthorized 401 (403 for a Host header the daemon does not answer to), not_allowed 403, not_found 404, canceled 408, limit_exceeded 429, internal 500, not_implemented 501, connect_failed, not_sunspec and discovery_failed 502.

attempts.description: The detection probes of a failed open or re-discovery (connect_failed, not_sunspec, discovery_failed).

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every HTTP answer with status 400 or above under /api/v1.
